opening.argument: The pitch combines unusually large upside framing with a direct call to accumulate. The speaker recounts a move “from nine cents all the way to around 60 cents in two months,” calls that “around eight five six seven x,” and says XLM can go above a dollar. He then urges viewers not to be discouraged and says these are times to get assets while they have time to accumulate. That combination can make a speculative token purchase feel like a timely wealth opportunity, despite the uncertainty.
